title: I Am Not a Perfect Person
author: Lis Syamsiah
text:
I am not a perfect person,
I have stumbled along the way.
I have made mistakes in silence,
And carried regrets every day.

There were times I lost my direction,
Times I doubted who I could be.
Yet through every storm and heartbreak,
Life kept teaching me gently.

I am not made of endless strength,
Sometimes my spirit feels weak and small.
But even when I fall a thousand times,
I find the courage to stand tall.

I do not seek a flawless journey,
Nor a life untouched by pain.
For every scar has told a story,
And every loss has brought me gain.

So if you see my imperfections,
Please know they are part of me.
A soul still learning, still growing,
Becoming who I'm meant to be.

I am not a perfect person,
But my heart remains sincere.
And as long as hope still lives within me,
I will continue without fear.

title: Don't Mistake My Silence for Foolishness
author: Lis Syamsiah
text:
Do not mistake my silence for foolishness, or my kindness for a lack of strength.

I have heard words that wounded deeply, yet I chose peace instead of revenge. I have seen deception behind smiling faces, yet I carried my dignity and walked away.

You may think I do not understand, because I do not argue. You may think I do not notice, because I do not complain.

But the heart that stays quiet often sees more than anyone realizes.

I know the difference between truth and lies, between respect and pretense, between those who stay for a season and those who stay for a lifetime.

So do not call me weak, and do not think I am blind.

I simply learned that not every battle is worth my voice, and not every insult deserves my attention.

One day you will understand: my silence was never ignorance— it was wisdom protecting a heart that had already endured enough.

title: Fake People
author: Lis Syamsiah
text:
They smiled at me with gentle eyes,
Spoke sweet words beneath bright skies.
I trusted hearts that seemed so true,
Never knowing what they would do.

They stood beside me when days were light,
But vanished slowly with the night.
Their promises faded like morning dew,
Leaving behind a different view.

Fake people wear the kindest face,
Yet honesty finds no resting place.
They teach painful lessons without a sound,
Showing how easily trust is broken down.

Still, I will not let bitterness grow,
For every wound helps wisdom show.
The false may leave, the masks may fall,
But a genuine heart outshines them all.

So let them go and walk away,
Truth will remain when shadows fade.
For those who are real need not pretend,
And loyal hearts stay until the end. ❤️

title: Don't Give Me Hope
author: Lis Syamsiah
text:
Don't give me hope
if you have no intention to stay.
A beautiful lie
hurts more than an honest goodbye.

I can survive the truth,
but I cannot survive
dreams that were never meant to live.

If your heart belongs elsewhere,
let your words follow it too.
Kindness without sincerity
can become another form of pain.

So don't promise forever
when you only mean today.
I'd rather walk through loneliness
than build my soul on borrowed hope.

title: I'm Tired of Waiting for You
author: Lis Syamsiah
text:
I waited through silent mornings, and countless nights where the moon became my only witness.

I held on to hope even when it slowly faded, believing that one day you would find your way back to me.

But waiting has its own kind of pain. It steals smiles, drains the heart, and teaches tears to fall without a sound.

I never asked for forever. I only wished for honesty, for one moment where you would choose me the way I always chose you.

Now my heart is exhausted. Not because I stopped loving you, but because I can no longer carry the weight of waiting alone.

If you were meant to stay, you would have never left me standing in the cold embrace of uncertainty.

So today, I let my tears become my farewell. I release the hope that kept me captive, and I choose to walk toward a future where peace finally finds my soul.

Even if you never return, a part of me will always remember that I loved you sincerely— until waiting became heavier than love itself.

title: Don't Love Too Much in a Virtual World!
author: Lis Syamsiah
text:
Don't pour your whole heart
into a screen that cannot hold your tears.

Some words are warm,
yet leave no footprints in your real life.
Some promises shine like stars,
only to disappear before sunrise.

Be kind.
Be caring.
But never lose yourself
trying to become someone's temporary comfort.

The saddest heartbreak
is not being left behind—
it is realizing you gave your soul
to someone who only knew your username.

Protect your heart.
Not everyone who says, "I care,"
knows how to stay.

Real love is not measured
by endless messages,
late-night calls,
or beautiful words.

It is measured
by honesty, loyalty,
and the courage to remain
when the world grows silent.

So if you must love,
love wisely.
If you must care,
care without forgetting your own worth.

Because a heart is too precious
to be broken
by someone
who only existed behind a screen.

title: A Tear Called Repentance
author: Lis Syamsiah
text:
I have carried the weight of countless yesterdays,
Hidden behind a smile the world believed.
But You, O Lord, saw every silent tear,
Every wound my heart could never conceal.

I searched for peace in places without light,
Only to find emptiness waiting for me.
The farther I walked away from You,
The more I lost the person I was meant to be.

Tonight, I come with nothing in my hands—
No pride, no excuses, no perfect words.
Only a heart shattered by its own mistakes,
Still hoping Your mercy has not forgotten my name.

If my tears can wash away my arrogance,

Then let them fall without shame.
If my brokenness can bring me closer to You,
Then let my soul break until it learns to love You alone.

I know I cannot rewrite yesterday,
But with Your forgiveness, I can begin again.
For Your mercy is deeper than my sins,
And Your love is stronger than my regrets.

So let my repentance become my rebirth.
Let every prayer become a step toward You.
And when this fleeting life comes to an end,
May my last breath whisper only one truth:

"My Lord, I returned to You... and You never turned me away."

title: Love Doesn't Have to Be Possession
author: Lis Syamsiah
text:
I loved you in silence,
Not because I was afraid,
But because some loves are too beautiful
To be measured by promises or names.

I never asked the stars to make you mine.
I only asked them
To let your heart find peace,
Even if that peace was never with me.

Perhaps we were never written
On the same page of destiny.
Yet every chapter where you existed
Made my life worth reading.

If one day you find someone
Who makes your soul smile brighter than I ever could,
Go without guilt...
For love was never meant to imprison.

The deepest love is not the one that holds on,
But the one that knows when to let go
Without allowing bitterness
To replace beautiful memories.

So I will love you from afar,
Like the moon loves the sea—
Never touching,
Yet forever lighting the darkness.

And if our paths never meet again,
Remember this:

You were never a mistake in my story.
You were the lesson that taught my heart
That true love is not about possession.

It is about wishing someone happiness,
Even when that happiness
Doesn't include you.

title: Don't Lie to Your Heart
author: Lis Syamsiah
text:
Don't lie to your heart, It has carried your secrets through silent nights and lonely tears.

You may hide behind a smile, pretend that everything is fine, but your heart knows the truth you try so hard to deny.

If you miss someone, admit it. If you are hurt, feel it. If you still dream, believe it.

A heart is not a prisoner meant to live behind walls of fear. It was created to feel, to hope, to love, and to heal

The world may ask you to be strong, but strength is not pretending. Strength is facing the truth even when it breaks you.

So don't lie to your heart. Listen to its quiet voice. For the longest journey in life is not finding others it is finding yourself.

title: Dear Mother
author: Lis Syamsiah
text:
Mother,

I saw your tired eyes
Long before I understood your sacrifices.
I saw your smile,
But I did not see the tears you hid behind it.
You carried burdens I never knew,

Fought battles you never spoke about,
And gave up pieces of your own dreams

So mine could have a chance to live.
When I was afraid,
You became my courage.
When I was lost,
You became my way home.

There were nights when the world was heavy on your shoulders,
Yet you still whispered,
"Everything will be okay."

Not because life was easy,
But because your love was stronger than your pain.
Now I understand that a mother's love
Is not measured by words,

But by silent sacrifices,
Sleepless nights,
And countless prayers.
One day your hair will turn silver,
And your hands will tremble with age.

But to me,
You will always be the woman
Who carried an entire world in her heart
And called it "my child."
Mother,

If I could give you one thing in this life,
It would be the ability to see yourself
Through my eyes.
Then you would finally know

How deeply you are loved,
How greatly you are admired,
And how impossible it would be
To replace you..

For a mother's love is the closest thing to heaven that we will ever know.

title: Never Give Up
author: Lis Syamsiah
text:
When the road is hard and steep, And your dreams seem far to keep, Do not surrender, do not fall, For every storm will pass after all.

There will be days of tears and pain, Days when effort feels in vain, But every challenge you go through Is shaping a stronger, wiser you.

The stars don't shine without the night, And diamonds are formed under pressure's might. Your struggles are not there to stay, They are building the person you'll be one day.

If others doubt what you can do, Keep believing in the best of you. The world belongs to hearts that try, To those who fall but still rise high.

So lift your head and stand once more, There are brighter days ahead in store. Your story is not ending today, The best chapters are on their way.

Never give up, no matter how far, Remember how valuable you truly are. One day you'll look back and clearly see, The person you fought so hard to be.

title: Tired of the Same Sky
author: Lis Syamsiah
text:
Sometimes I smile, but my heart feels tired.

The days pass by, wearing the same colors, telling the same stories, and carrying the same silence.

I look at the sky and wonder, is there something more waiting for me beyond these ordinary moments?

Being bored is not always emptiness. Sometimes it is the soul whispering, "You were made for more."

So do not fear these quiet days. Even the longest night cannot stop the morning from arriving.

A new chapter is coming, a new dream is growing, and a new version of you is being formed in the unseen.

Hold on.

The road may seem endless today, but one day you will look back and realize that this season of boredom was only preparing your heart for something beautiful.

Keep believing. The best pages of your story have not been written yet.

title: Myself
author: Lis Syamsiah
text:
I looked into the mirror today,
And saw a soul tired from yesterday.
A heart that carried silent pain,
Yet still stood up through every rain.

I have been broken, I have cried,
Kept many storms locked deep inside.
But every scar upon my skin
Reminds me where I've always been.

I am not perfect, nor am I strong
Sometimes I stumble and get things wrong.
Yet through the darkness, I still find light,
A reason to continue the fight.

So today, I choose to believe,
In the dreams my heart still weaves.
For even when the world says "No,"
My soul whispers, "You can grow."

And if no one sees my worth today,
I will not let my hope fade away.
Because deep within, I finally see
The person I need is simply me.

title: The Beauty of Sacrifice
author: Lis Syamsiah
text:
Some sacrifices are never spoken,
they live quietly behind a gentle smile.
The world may never see the tears,
or the battles fought in silence all the while.

A mother gives up her comfort,
a father carries burdens untold
A loving heart chooses another's happiness,
even when its own nights feel cold.

Sacrifice is not weakness,
nor is it losing who you are.
It is loving beyond your own pain,
like a candle burning to become someone's star.

Many will forget what was given,
many will never understand the cost.
But every act of selfless love
is never truly lost.

For the greatest hearts are not measured
by wealth, success, or fame.
They are remembered for the sacrifices made
without expecting anything in return.

And though sacrifice may leave scars,
it also leaves a beautiful light
the light of a soul that chose love,
even when the journey was hard to fight.

So if your sacrifices go unseen,
do not let your heart despair.
The purest love is often hidden,
but its beauty remains everywhere.

title: I Miss the Child I Used to Be
author: Lis Syamsiah
text:
I miss the child I used to be,
The one who laughed so wild and free.
With dreams as vast as the open sky,
And wings of hope that longed to fly.

I miss the days of simple joy,
A little girl, a little boy,
Finding treasures in the sand,
Holding happiness in tiny hands.

Back then, the world seemed kind and bright,
Every morning filled with light.
No heavy burdens, no silent fears,
No hidden pain behind the years.

I miss the sound of carefree laughter,
Before life taught me what comes after.
Before goodbyes became so real,
And scars became things I could feel.

The old streets still live in my mind,
With memories time could never bind.
Though years have passed and seasons flew,
My heart still wanders back to you.

If I could have just one more day,
I'd run through childhood's golden way.
Not to change a single thing,
But to hear my younger heart still sing.

Yet as I walk through life today,
I carry those memories on my way.
For the child I was still lives in me,
A gentle reminder of who I can be.

And though I cannot return again,
To fields of sunshine free from pain,
I hold those moments, pure and true
A piece of my heart forever new.
"Sometimes the deepest longing is not for a place, but for the person we once were."

title: Between Hate and Love
author: Lis Syamsiah
text:
I told my heart to forget you,
To lock your memories away,
Yet every silent night I find
Your shadow where my feelings stay.

I tried to hate the way you left,
The words that cut so deep inside,
But every wound became a path
To all the tears I could not hide.

How strange it is that love can bloom
Where broken pieces fall apart,
And even when I whisper "go,"
Your name still echoes in my heart.

Between hate and love I stand,
Lost within a storm unseen,
One side burns with pain and pride,
The other keeps a fragile dream.

Perhaps true love is not forgetting,
Nor holding on with desperate hands,
But learning to carry the memories
While accepting what life demands.

So if one day our paths divide
And distance writes the final line,
Know that somewhere in my soul
A part of you will still be mine.

title: Let Me Go
author: Lis Syamsiah
text:
If my presence only brings you pain,
Then let me go like the evening rain.
Do not hold the pieces of what used to be,
For love should never live without being free.

I came with a heart sincere and true,
Carrying dreams that once belonged to you.
But some stories are written to end,
No matter how hard we try to pretend.

Let me go with the
memories we made,
The laughter, the tears, the promises that fade.
Do not look back with anger or regret,
Some goodbyes are lessons we never forget.

And when the silence fills the air tonight,
Remember that I loved you with all my might.
Yet sometimes love means walking away,
So another soul can find a brighter day.

Let me go, not because I never cared,
But because some burdens were not meant to be shared.
I'll carry the scars, the hope, and the pain,
And learn how to smile in the sunshine again.

So let me go gently, without a fight,
Like a fading star disappearing into the night.
For even when distance keeps us apart,
A piece of you will remain in my heart.

title: Solitude
author: Lis Syamsiah
text:
The room is quiet,
yet my thoughts are loud.
A thousand memories whisper my name
through the silence of the night.

I sit beside the window,
watching the stars from afar,
wondering if they too feel lonely,
shining brightly while standing alone.

There are days when I smile,
and no one sees the tears behind it.
Days when my heart grows heavy,
yet I carry the weight in silence.

Loneliness is a strange companion.
It never speaks,
yet it understands every sorrow
hidden deep within my soul.

Sometimes I miss the warmth of a voice,
the comfort of a caring heart,
someone who would stay
without being asked to.

But in the depths of solitude,
I have found a quiet truth:
even when the world feels distant,
I am still here, still standing.

And perhaps one day,
after all the lonely nights have passed,
the dawn will find me smiling again,
stronger than the pain I carried alone.

Until then,
I will walk with my solitude,
not as an enemy,
but as a teacher of strength

"Sometimes the loneliest hearts are the ones that learn to shine the brightest."

title: Sleepy Eyes, Brave Heart
author: Lis Syamsiah
text:
My eyes are heavy, my head feels slow,
Like a tired traveler with nowhere to go.
I try to stay focused, I try to be strong,
But my eyelids keep singing a sleepy song.

The clock keeps ticking, the work isn't done,
Yet my pillow is calling, "Come, have some fun!"
I fight like a warrior through every yawn,
But somehow my courage is nearly gone.

I read one sentence, then read it again,
And suddenly forget it within seconds, my friend.
I hold my phone tightly, determined to stay,
Then almost drop it and drift away.

Still, there is beauty in moments like these,
When life softly whispers, "Slow down, please."
For even the strongest hearts need rest,
And tired souls deserve the very best.

So if I fall asleep before I say goodnight,
Don't think I've surrendered the fight.
I'm simply borrowing dreams for a while,
And hopefully waking up with a brighter smile.
